projects.title: Pandemic Code Red
projects.description:
Pandemic board game web application version of the game 
- Built with React front end and Firebase for database manipulation for changes of state of board game.
- Visual map displays using React simple maps library with svg manipulation done on frontend.

projects.title: Cage Shopper
projects.description:
Fully functional e-commerce website selling Nicholas Cage products
- Developed e-commerce website with user functionality such as login/logout and cart creation by using Node.js to build the server-side and React/Redux framework to handle user interface. I integrated the Stripe API in the web application for payment functionality.

organizations.name: Cerritos Korean Seventh-Day Adventist Church
organizations.description: During the medical mission trip with the Cerritos Korean Seventh-Day Adventist Church, I had the opportunity to provide medical care and healthcare education to communities in Peru where healthcare is limited or difficult to obtain. My tasks were to shadow doctors and dentists and working under instruction, I played an important role in providing essential care within a under-resourced clinic we created.
